cases.name: Sereniti Jazzlynn-Sky Blankenship-Sutley
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Sereniti was a loveable little girl who brought a smile to your face. Her personality was bright and her smile was contagious. She loved Scooby Doo, playing video games with her mom, and sleeping with her favorite monkey her grandma made for her. Although her time here was short, the lasting memories she brought to her family will forever be treasured."
cases.narrative: On 10/7/2017, her mother found mother found her unresponsive during the early morning hours.
